snippet.title: 7 minutes of raw gameplay of the Myth Landers demo
snippet.description: This is a short snippet of raw gameplay to demonstrate the game Myth Landers. The game is in active development. You can find the demo version on Game Jolt https://gamejolt.com/games/myth_landers/850475 or itch.io https://combat-dices-team.itch.io/myth-landers. Don't forget to add the game to wish lists on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/1910770/Myth_Landers, as well as leave likes and feedback. Thank you for watching!
